name: Flight Planning & Monitoring
description: Flight planning and monitoring in 14 chapters: aeronautical information publications, fuel policy and in-flight fuel monitoring, air and ground distance, planning with single-engine piston, multi-engine piston and medium range jet data, extended range twin operations, tankering and computer flight plans, VFR and IFR charts, the ATC flight plan, and the point of equal time and point of safe return.
